newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY'S GIRIBALDI UPS CIR STAKE TO 20 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ITALY'S GIRIBALDI UPS CIR STAKE TO 20 PCT.

text.p: Banque du Gothard has raised its stake in Italian industrial holding company CIR, almost all held on behalf of Monaco-based businessman Luigi Giribaldi, to 20.546 percent on July 18, a Milan bourse statement said.
The bank holds 20.503 percent of CIR, the industrial holding of Carlo De Benedetti, on behalf of Giribaldi, and the rest for other investors.
On July 8, the bank's CIR holding was 19.058 percent.

Giribaldi also has a stake of some 20 percent in Cofide, De Benedetti's financial holding which controls CIR which in turn is the largest single shareholder in high-tech group Olivetti. Giribaldi also has a one percent stake in Olivetti.
